Q: This is the adjuster with the claims department. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported. Do
you understand that this call is being recorded and that you consent to it?
A: Yes, I understand and I consent.
Q: Thank you. Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.
A: I was driving on a city street in Houston, Texas, heading toward a shopping center. I was in the left-turn lane at a
signalized intersection, waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.
Q: What happened when you started the turn?
A: The light turned green for my direction, and I began to turn left. A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the
front driver's side of my car as I crossed into its path.
Q: Did you see that vehicle before you started moving?
A: I saw headlights earlier, but it looked far enough away that I thought I had time. I should have waited a bit longer.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My neck is sore and stiff, and I have pain across my lower back. I was sitting in the car for a while before
paramedics arrived, and the pain has been getting worse since then.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment yet?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening. They took X-rays and told me I have a neck and back strain. I
was given medication and told to rest and follow up with my own doctor.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes, sitting for long periods and turning my head to the left are the hardest. I have been taking the pills as
prescribed and using a heating pad.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I will provide the clinic records if you need them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
